page: Amazon Web Services trn2.48xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture, targeted at deep learning training and large-scale model workloads. The server integrates 16 AWS Trainium2 accelerators providing a cumulative 1536 GB of accelerator memory (VRAM). Compute is driven by Intel x86_64 processors with 192 dedicated vCPUs across 96 physical cores clocked at 3.5 GHz, paired with 2048 GB of system memory, delivering roughly 10.67 GB of RAM per physical core.

Data throughput and local caching are supported by 7600 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage. The network architecture supplies a 3200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large multi-node distributed training synchronization and massive parallel dataset ingestion. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The trn2.48xlarge instance provides high hardware resource density across compute, accelerator capacity, and networking. While benchmark metrics are unavailable, the combination of 16 Trainium2 accelerators, high-speed local NVMe storage, and 3200 Gbps interconnect optimizes execution for distributed machine learning training, generative AI models, foundation model pre-training, and large language model fine-tuning pipelines.
